name: Peach Blossoms Look Like a Memory
overview:
Wu Li has been neglected by her father and stepmother since she was a child. When she grew up, she chose Wen Yan Ci as her personal bodyguard. Gradually, Ruan Wuli fell in love with Wen Yan Ci and pursued him madly, but Wen Yan Ci was always unmoved. Ruan Wu Li accidentally discovered that Wen Yan Ci came for her stepsister, and his real identity was the prince of the Wen family.

(Source: Chinese = Weibo || Translation = MyDramaList)
